verdict.rationale: Attio's workflows page markets a 'Routing Agent' that 'routes every lead to the right rep or channel'. It also shows a 'when a new deal is created' trigger feeding a custom agent that will 'score the lead and route to the right AE', inside a documented visual Workflows builder. This is marketing-level, AI-agent routing; nothing documents configurable assignment rules, round-robin distribution, or how the owner field is set. Missing for 10: documented assignment-rule configuration, round-robin or load-balanced distribution, owner-field assignment details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
